_readme: Starter list of public sites that commonly accept listings or profiles. These are NOT guaranteed backlinks: each one is fetched and assessed during discovery, and many will correctly end up as 'requires login'. Edit freely. Fields: name, url, category, hint_status (login|captcha|outreach|''), notes.

sources.name: Curlie (open directory)
sources.notes: Human-edited directory. Suggestions are reviewed by volunteer editors and may take a long time or be declined.

sources.name: Product Hunt
sources.notes: Launch listing; requires an account. Links are typically nofollow.

sources.name: BetaList
sources.notes: Startup submissions; review process and possible fee for fast-track.

sources.name: Indie Hackers
sources.notes: Creator and product profiles; account required.

sources.name: GitHub
sources.notes: Project README, profile and documentation links. Requires your own account.

sources.name: GitLab
sources.notes: Project pages and docs. Requires your own account.

sources.name: DEV Community
sources.notes: Contributed articles and profile; account required; many links are nofollow.

sources.name: Crunchbase
sources.notes: Company profile; account required, edits are moderated.

sources.name: SaaSHub
sources.notes: Software directory with a submission page; verify the rules on the site.

sources.name: F6S
sources.notes: Startup and company profile; account required.
